method: Parse visible ODE and choice coefficients, express each choice as H(x,y,C)=0 and compute H_x+H_y*f(x,y). Exactly the keyed candidate has zero derivative. Nonzero residuals are witnessed at both positive and negative nonsingular points. No generator components or generation metadata used.
domain: Real x,y nonzero for cubic; x nonzero for other families. log(abs(x)) differentiates to 1/x on either interval. Cubic is represented implicitly so real negative cube roots are included.
